## Summary

Describe the change and its user-facing effect.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] Ran `pre-commit run --all-files`.
- [ ] Ran `pytest`.
- [ ] No token, credential, or sensitive response is included.

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated when needed.
- [ ] The pull request is focused on one change.
